breakdown.description: The simulation is for natural convection in a fluid layer heated from below (along Z-axis), but gravity is applied horizontally (in the -X direction), which will not drive the vertical buoyant instability.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The simulation is for natural convection in a fluid layer heated from below (along the Z-axis), which requires gravity to act vertically to drive the buoyant instability. The agent specified the gravity vector as `(-9.81 0 0)`, which is horizontal (in the -X direction) and will not produce the intended Rayleigh-Bénard convection.
